summary: First-iteration full-stack testing of Rudralife landing page. Backend (6/6 pytest passing) covers GET /api/, POST /api/register happy-path + 422 validation (invalid email, missing required field), optional message defaulting, and GET /api/registrations ordered most-recent-first. Frontend Playwright covered hero, navbar, exhibitions tabs (16 domestic/4 international), LIVE NOW badges (Hyderabad/Visakhapatnam/Bengaluru), city-card expansion with detail panel, full 3-step registration modal end-to-end culminating in success screen ('Registration Confirmed' with gold check), ESC close, overlay-click close, FAQ accordion toggle (aria-expanded flips), expert card click/flip, collection section, and footprint section. No critical bugs detected.

integration_issues.issue: hero-register-btn scrolls to Exhibitions section instead of opening the registration modal directly. Navbar REGISTER and per-city 'Register Now →' open the modal. This appears intentional (App.js onRegister={scrollToExhibitions}) but the PRD implies hero 'Register Now' should register. Flag for product confirmation.

issues: React console warning: 'Invalid DOM property stroke-linecap. Did you mean strokeLinecap' — some SVG element uses kebab-case prop. Cosmetic, non-blocking.

action_items: Decide intended behavior of hero-register-btn: scroll to exhibitions (current) vs open registration modal directly. If modal expected, switch App.js Hero onRegister to openRegistration() instead of scrollToExhibitions.
Fix SVG prop casing (stroke-linecap -> strokeLinecap) to silence React dev warning. Search in Hero.jsx / mandala SVG components.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores datetime as ISO string on insert but response_model=Registration expects datetime; current code reads back and converts — works, but consider always storing BSON datetime for simpler queries/sorting.
GET /api/registrations sorts by created_at string ISO; works for UTC ISO but will break if any entry has non-ISO string. Safe now but document invariant.
No auth/rate limiting on POST /api/register — public endpoint vulnerable to spam. Consider captcha / rate limit for production.
Hero Register CTA UX: users expect clicking 'Register Now' to open the registration form; currently it scrolls. Verify intent with product.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; one behavior flag on hero CTA)
